body: Guam is a United States overseas territory and is counted as the US for country streak purposes.
Guam’s Google car is fully blurred, but an antenna at the front right and part of a roof rack are visible; the Northern Mariana Islands car lacks a roof rack.
Poles on Guam are almost always thick concrete, while Northern Mariana Islands poles typically are wooden.
Guam uses green street signs, unlike the Northern Mariana Islands which use blue.
Guam has a tropical climate with dense, somewhat low vegetation.
Both Guam and Northern Mariana Islands have a large number of road reflectors.
East Asian languages like Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Russian are commonly seen in Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands.
Coverage in Guam is limited, especially in the southern half, where inland coverage is nearly absent.
Hills dominate the southern half of Guam.
The northern half of the island is mostly flat.
Some signposts near the town of Apra View are yellow colored.
LeoPalace Resort is recognized by its white buildings with orange tiled roofs, resembling similar roofs in Java.
